environment_notes: The host Python lacked pytest; the authorized isolated uv environment supplied pytest without changing repository dependency files.
The first Python attempt used the default audit spool path, which the sandbox could not create; write-path cases returned 503. The successful rerun used a private temporary spool path.

browser_consent_setup.state: The page is waiting at Create your offline vault. The user must enter a new local test passphrase directly in the browser before the consent UI can be exercised.
browser_consent_setup.writes: No forms or sync calls have been sent; the candidate database and locked existing browser profile were not touched.

limits: These source-level checks do not replace real-device airplane-mode testing, a real OIDC provider, or browser consent acceptance.
The browser fixture is not the candidate Gateway and creates no persistent application data.
rollback: No source changes or application-data writes were made by the test run; the temporary audit spool and isolated pytest cache can be removed independently.
